title: A configuration-only agent, an Agent with no model, is taken as a Supervisor's supervisor; it can neither frame nor judge a step, so its sequential team runs unsupervised, each worker given the task and the work done before it
notes: The supervisor is the implementation's configuration-only Agent (README, Scripted agents, `agent` with `model: null`); its turns are auto-delegated, without refining the task. Where a supervisor with a model frames each step and judges it (orchestration/a-supervised-team-has-each-step-framed-and-checked), the first worker is handed the message and the second the message and the first one's work. The supervisor's own turn, which presents the team's work, asks its null provider, which refuses: what the room then reads is not asserted (a voice supervisor, the configuration-only agent's use, presents nothing; option O1). Cited in part: RK-19.1-014, an Agent with no provider accepted, registered and held by the strategy; that no generation call is made, and the speech-to-speech channel it is a configuration for, are not observed (option O1). Python: channels/agent.py Agent(provider=None), is_config_only; orchestration/strategies/supervisor/delegate.py _run_workers, _supervises; execution.py _run_sequential; tests/orchestration/test_supervisor_text_background.py::test_a_supervisor_without_a_model_lets_its_chain_run_unsupervised.
